## Fixed the login redirect

The session cookie was **dropped** on the *second* hop, so `conn.assigns.current_user` came back `nil`. Changes:

- `lib/app_web/router.ex`: keep the session through `:redirect_back`
- a regression test in `test/app_web/live/login_test.exs`
- see [the Phoenix docs](https://hexdocs.pm/phoenix) for `put_session/3`

> Nothing else in the router changed.

```rust
fn main() {
    let answer: u32 = 42; // the answer
    println!("{answer}");
}
```

All 486 tests pass; a very long line follows so the preview has to wrap it across more than one row of the card without losing the inline `code` colour in the middle of it.
The login redirect loses the session. Can you fix it?
